lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Alpha wing, Babylon 5 Control. You're cleared through to NAV ALPHA.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: A freighter skipper reports raiders headed your way. They want the relay.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Keep them off NAV ALPHA. Without it, nothing out there finds its way home.

lines.speaker: alpha_2
lines.text: Copy, Control. Alpha 2 on your wing, leader.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Alpha leader, the flight is yours. Good hunting.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Jump point opening off your port side. Three raiders, making for the buoy.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Alpha, second jump signature, starboard and low. Four more inbound.

lines.speaker: raider_lead
lines.text: Leave us the beacon, Earthers, and you all go home tonight.

lines.speaker: alpha_3
lines.text: Tally four. They're going straight for the relay!

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Scope's clean and NAV ALPHA is still talking. Nice flying, Alpha wing.

lines.speaker: alpha_2
lines.text: Forming up on you, leader. Let's go home.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: We've lost NAV ALPHA. Alpha wing, come home.

lines.speaker: alpha_2
lines.text: Leader's down! Control, Alpha leader is down!
